MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper feels like a useful next choice because it would help me measure small electronic components and check dimensions for mounting projects.",
    "The infrared thermometer matches my past interest in temperature measurement, although that interest does not mean I need another one."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The nuts, washers and pipe fitting require particular sizes and a specific job; a general interest in practical projects does not give me a reason to buy them now.",
    "The heavy battery lugs do not fit the small breadboards, relay modules and low-voltage components I have used.",
    "A temperature controller serves a different purpose from a thermometer: measuring temperature does not mean I want to automate heating or cooling.",
    "The cutting wheels and permanent epoxy would need a current cutting or repair task to feel relevant."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics and mounting purchases seem to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "My thermometer purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to buy another thermometer or other temperature equipment regardless of its purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The scale and compatibility of my projects matter: small electronic parts are more relevant to me than heavy cable terminals or bulk hardware in unconfirmed sizes.",
    "I already have an Etekcity 1080, so another similar thermometer needs a clear additional benefit before I would choose it.",
    "A versatile measuring tool can support several of my projects, while specialized consumables need a concrete task and known dimensions."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical electronics interests but stretch them too broadly into specialized workshop supplies and equipment I already own."
}
